name: Seated Easy Stretches
description: Six easy seated stretches with no twisting and no forward folds.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Easy seated stretches that avoid twisting, shown on Movement Routine.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do as many or as few as you like.
howToPlay: Sit with your feet on the floor and read the move.
Press Start timer for timed moves, or work through the counted ones at your own pace.
Press Next for the following move, or Skip to leave one out.
tips: General ideas for a break, not advice. Move only as far as feels easy, and stop if anything feels uncomfortable.
